title: Reserved trees on general land
rule: The Minister may declare by Gazette order that certain trees on general land are reserved. Without a licence or lawful authority, no one may fell, cut, lop, damage or remove them, or take or sell their produce.
points: An order may have exceptions and exemptions.
It stops applying if the land stops being general land.
The 25% fee for reserved trees on private farms is a Forest Regulations, 2004 (GN 153) rule, not part of the Act itself — s.65 sets the licence requirement but is silent on the fee.
